question: What is the function of Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) under JMC No. 2021-01 in commercial business permitting?
answer: The Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) under JMC No. 2021-01 serve the function of conducting inspections of an applicant's office/premises, in relation to an application for a new business permit or renewal. This is to limit the face-to-face interaction between the applicant and the LGU officials, as stated in Section 9.1.2 of JMC No. 01 Series of 2021 [S1].
